name: qa_playcur
title: OS-PLAYCUR, Pattern: Shift + Play plays from the cursor's row (stopped: starts there; playing: the play line jumps there at the next step; never a count-in). Edits nothing; by ear and by the state read-out

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(stopped, Rec in Edit (STEP) goes back to WATCH: the scenario starts in WATCH, mode 3)

steps.say: OS-PLAYCUR, rows QA-PAT-231..234 of docs/qa/catalogue/pattern.md (docs/specs/OS-RECFLOW.md). For check 1 set Config > PATTERN > COUNT-IN to 2 BARS first (a persistent setting: put it back afterwards): Shift + Play must not count in.

CHECK 1 (QA-PAT-231): stopped, move the cursor to about row 21 (Down), then Shift + Play. The pattern starts on that row at once: no countdown, no click-only bars, the first sound is the row's own step.

steps.note: the play line is on or just past row 21 (read it; it must not have started from row 1)

steps.say: CHECK 2 (QA-PAT-232): playing, press REC for a free cursor (STEP), move the cursor to about row 33 with Down, then Shift + Play. The play line jumps to row 33 on the next step and goes on from there; the song does not stop, the chip stays STEP. Listen: no step repeats or is skipped around the jump.

steps.note: STEP while playing: a free cursor
Shift + Play while playing: the line jumps to the cursor's row
the play line is on or just past the cursor's row

steps.say: CHECK 3 (QA-PAT-233): Shift + Down a few times to select a block, then Shift + Play: the same jump from the cursor's row, the block stays selected.
Put COUNT-IN back to OFF if you changed it. In the report: any count-in on Shift + Play? did a step repeat or drop at the jump?
